item.title: Every time I see a ‘Your Pennies at Work’ sign I question how much has been spent on road patches
item.description: "We moved into the Lynn area in 1996; our particular street has been patched a million times over from end to end. It is a short cut from Sharps Ferry Road to SR 40. When was the last time it's been resurfaced? In 1996, it was bad. It's even worse now. Every time I seen a sign saying "your pennies at work," I have to wonder how many pennies have been wasted on all the patches they lay down each year?
